name: The Malaysia Spell
hook: Jalan Alor nights. Batu Caves mornings. The Weeknd at Bukit Jalil. Then the highlands and Penang, if you stay on.

packages.name: Kuala Lumpur Highlights
packages.summary: Land at KLIA, Bukit Bintang and the Jalan Alor food crawl, Batu Caves, the show at National Stadium Bukit Jalil, the Petronas Skybridge and KLCC Park, then the airport.

packages.name: City, Highlands & Heritage
packages.summary: Everything in Kuala Lumpur Highlights, then the Cameron Highlands, George Town and Penang National Park, flying out of Penang or taking the train back to KLIA.

imageNote: AI-generated Malaysia-inspired artwork illustrates the atmosphere; it is not photography of the venues, the hotels, the concert or the event.

days.title: Arrival & Night Market Crawl
days.intro: Land, check in and eat your way down Jalan Alor.

points.title: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur
points.body: Land at KLIA. Check into Bukit Bintang.

points.title: Jalan Alor night market crawl
points.body: Street food dinner crawl along Jalan Alor (satay, grilled stingray, coconut ice cream).

days.title: Batu Caves & Concert Night
days.intro: Limestone temples in the morning. The show at Bukit Jalil by night.

points.title: Batu Caves
points.body: Morning excursion to the limestone temples at Batu Caves.

points.title: The Weeknd · National Stadium Bukit Jalil · 8:30 PM
points.body: Rest in the afternoon before heading via the Sri Petaling LRT line directly to National Stadium Bukit Jalil for the show.

days.title: Skyline Views & Departure
days.intro: The Skybridge, the park, and the point where the two packages part ways.

points.title: Petronas Twin Towers Skybridge & KLCC Park
points.body: Visit the Petronas Twin Towers Skybridge and KLCC Park before heading to the airport.

days.closing: Kuala Lumpur Highlights ends here, at the airport. City, Highlands & Heritage carries on to the Cameron Highlands tomorrow.

days.title: Rainforests of Cameron Highlands
days.intro: Up into the mist: mossy trails and tea as far as you can see.

points.title: The road to the Cameron Highlands
Mossy Forest & the Sungai Palas tea plantations
points.body: Hike the Mossy Forest trails, explore the rolling tea plantations of Sungai Palas, and stay in the cool mountain climate.

days.closing: A night in the cool mountain climate.

days.title: Colonial Charm & Heritage in George Town
days.intro: Down to the coast for shophouses, street art and the best hawker food in the country.

points.title: George Town’s street art & Clan Jetties
points.body: Explore the UNESCO street art alleys and Clan Jetties in George Town.

points.title: Hawker food on Chulia Street
points.body: Indulge in world-famous hawker foods (Char Kway Teow, Assam Laksa) at Chulia Street.

days.closing: Penang, for the rest of the spell.

days.title: Penang National Park & Monkey Beach
days.intro: Jungle trail or boat, a beach at the end of it, and a sunset to close the day.

points.title: Penang National Park
points.body: Hike through Penang National Park to Monkey Beach or take a boat to Kerachut Beach.

days.closing: The last night of the spell.

days.title: Return to KL / Departure from Penang
days.intro: One last Penang morning, then home by air or by rail.

points.title: Fly out of Penang or train back to KLIA
points.body: Fly out directly via Penang International Airport (PEN) or train back to KLIA.
